name: Switch!! ~Boku ga Natsu ni Omou Koto~
original_name: すいっチ!! ～ボクがナツに想うこと～
source:
The main character is a university student. One day, when he is asleep, he feels something strange. And when he wakes up, he finds some girls standing in front of him. What leads the girls to his room...? For what...? 

[From ErogeShop]
